scope: Exploratory Development post-hoc analysis, not a Final lock or controller change
station_weighting: Equal station after paired seed mean; retain budget/initialization strata
bootstrap_rationale: Weekly calendar blocks; common calendar draws across stations; fixed paired seeds; gaps stay missing
multiple_comparisons: No simultaneous correction; exploratory marginal intervals only
audit: Descriptive normalized new-minus-old gaps only; no harmful-switch threshold or recovery time invented
